project_type: React 18 + Vite 6 + TypeScript SPA with Supabase backend and Deno Edge Functions
build_system: pnpm with Vite 6, mise for node version management (node 22). Must run: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && corepack enable before pnpm commands
test_framework: No test framework configured (no test command in package.json)
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/stockflow-inventory-crm && eval "$(mise activate bash)" && corepack enable && pnpm build
test_command: N/A - no test suite. TypeScript build (tsc -b) serves as type checking.
verification_instructions: Run pnpm build which runs tsc -b && vite build. Must pass with zero errors.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/stockflow-inventory-crm && mise trust && MISE_NODE_VERIFY=false mise install node@22 && eval "$(mise activate bash)" && corepack enable && pnpm install
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node 22 via mise (must trust + activate). pnpm as package manager. TypeScript strict with noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict (zero errors), pnpm build must pass, dark spatial glassmorphism design system, path aliases via @/, framer-motion animations
key_patterns: TanStack Query 5 for data fetching hooks (useQuery/useMutation), Supabase client at src/lib/supabase.ts, Lucide icons, radix-ui + tailwind + class-variance-authority for UI components, motion/react for animations, lazy-loaded pages in App.tsx, Sidebar nav sections in src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx
directory_structure: src/pages/ (page components by domain), src/hooks/ (TanStack Query hooks), src/services/ai/ (AI infrastructure), src/components/layout/ (AppShell, Sidebar, TopNav), src/components/ui/ (shadcn components), src/components/shared/ (shared components), src/types/ (TypeScript types), src/lib/ (utilities), supabase/functions/ (Edge Functions), supabase/migrations/ (SQL migrations)
